newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 1.0, 0.25-pct March diesel.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 1.0, 0.25-pct March diesel.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 1.0-and-0.25-percent sulphur diesel for deliveries in March, traders said on Monday.
The tender closes on January 23 and is valid until January 24.

It seeks 40,000-to-45,000-tonne cargoes of 1.0 percent sulphur diesel for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the east coast and to Kandla on the west coast. It also seeks 30,000-tonne cargoes of this diesel grade for delivery to Goa or Kandla.
The 0.25-percent sulphur cargoes are for delivery to Kandla anytime in March.
India bought a total of 810,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur diesel and 45,000 tonnes of the 0.25-percent sulphur grade in two tenders for February delivery cargoes.
